title: The problem: completion without proof
narration: An agent saying done is not evidence that the work is complete. Marketplace listings go stale, deployments fail silently, and plausible answers can hide missing or contradictory facts. Proofline turns that acceptance boundary into something executable. It starts from a task contract, names each requirement, and refuses to call the work complete until fresh authoritative evidence supports every one.

title: Architecture: reasoning separated from acceptance
narration: Proofline uses Gemini 3.6 Flash and Google Agent Development Kit to interpret requirements and explain results. Fresh evidence then reaches a small deterministic gate. The gate, not the language model, decides whether the packet needs evidence, contains a conflict, requires human approval, or is ready. Cloud Run hosts the live agent API. Firestore and Pub Sub are documented extension points for durable packets and asynchronous rechecks. External actions stay behind an explicit human approval boundary.

title: Reproducible decision matrix
narration: The public repository includes a fixed-time synthetic demonstration of every possible decision. Missing evidence returns NEEDS EVIDENCE. Two fresh authoritative sources that disagree return CONFLICT. Valid evidence plus an unapproved external action returns APPROVAL REQUIRED. Only valid evidence with explicit approval returns READY. Each result includes a SHA 256 hash over the exact canonical packet. Nine focused tests cover the decision surface, stale and non-authoritative evidence, stable hashing, the approval gate, and the container contract. No credentials or network access are needed to reproduce these results.

title: Real Google ADK application surface
narration: This is not a slide-only mockup. Google ADK version 2.6.2 loads Proofline as a real Python application and root agent. Its Fast API server exposes health, discovery, session, artifact, run, and streaming routes. The app information endpoint identifies the evaluate packet tool and its JSON contract. In the credential-free preflight, health, list apps, app info, and the Open API document all returned HTTP 200. The server was stopped after validation, and every command and measured result is published in the repository.

title: Live Google Cloud evidence
narration: Proofline is live on Google Cloud Run in Europe West One as revision proofline zero zero zero zero one R Q W. An external request returned HTTP 200, discovered the Proofline app, created a real ADK session, and invoked Gemini 3.6 Flash. Gemini called the evaluate packet tool, which returned READY with one authoritative evidence item and a tamper evident packet hash. The public repository records the exact URL, revision, configuration, result, and reproduction evidence.

title: Proof before finish
narration: Proofline does not make agents sound more certain. It makes their completion claims inspectable, tamper-evident, and safe to act on. The code, tests, decision matrix, architecture, and ADK preflight are public. Proof before finish.
